chapter: Woody Herman and life on the road
title: Learning the Woody book from Jake Hanna records
summary: Joe learned Woody's charts by listening to Jake Hanna on the Woody '63 albums.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: Was there music, this is sort of a similar question about when you were in the family band, was there drum music for most of Woody’s charts?

There absolutely was but like most of my predecessors from that era, and even drummers that followed me, we learned Woody’s book from listening to Jake Hanna play it, you know, on all of those “Woody ‘63” and there’s like three albums I think that they did around that time where Jake just kills it. And we listened to them so many times that, I know Jeff Hamilton says the same thing, we knew that book cold before we even walked into the gig.
